about_short_description.short_description: Enflux provides the most powerful decision support platform for higher education.

product.name: Enflux Higher Education Analytics Platform
product.description: A higher education data analytics and decision-support platform that unifies assessment, LMS, survey, academic, and clinical data for program evaluation, student success, curriculum oversight, and accreditation reporting.

product.name: CompetencyGenie™
product.description: An AI-powered assessment classification tool that categorizes exam items by cognitive level and competency to support curriculum mapping, exam blueprinting, and competency-based assessment.

product.name: Accreditation Intelligence™
product.description: An AI-powered solution for Physician Assistant programs that supports ARC-PA C1.01 self-study reporting, PANCE readiness analysis, and continuous program improvement.

product.name: Enflux EDU Suite
product.description: A set of dashboards that centralizes ExamSoft assessment data for analyzing item effectiveness, curricular intent, student performance outcomes, and tagging fidelity.

product.name: IPEDS Peer Report
product.description: An off-the-shelf reporting tool that converts IPEDS data into visual comparisons of higher education institutions, academic programs, enrollment, completions, demographics, and related trends.

product.name: NPTE® & PEAT® Monitoring Suite
product.description: A physical therapy education analytics suite for monitoring and benchmarking student and program performance related to the NPTE® and PEAT® examinations.
